verses.1: Hallelujah! Those who fear the LORD and obey His commandments, they truly desire to do so.
verses.2: A ruler who comes to this land will have a descendants who will live in righteousness and be blessed.
verses.3: He has many houses, and his righteousness stands forever.
verses.4: Light shone in the darkness for those who are righteous, kind, and compassionate.
verses.5: A good man is one who is wise and knows how to manage his affairs in a just manner.
verses.6: For ever, it will never be forgotten; it will always remain a good memory.
verses.7: He who hears bad news will not be afraid; his heart will not tremble in fear.
verses.8: His heart is not afraid, even when he sees his own hardships.
verses.9: He granted justice to the elderly; his righteousness stands forever. His kindness continues to benefit us.
verses.10: The wicked will be hated, and their anger will cause them to cry out in pain. The hatred of the wicked will lead to their destruction.
